dedupe_keys.name: norwegian coastal administration kystverket open real time ais data stream

description: The Norwegian Coastal Administration provides real-time AIS (Automatic Identification System) vessel data from its coastal AIS network, either as a raw data stream or as online traffic information on charts. The network has an open component available to everyone and a closed component for registered users. Coverage: vessels within the Norwegian economic zone and the protection zones off Svalbard and Jan Mayen; the open data exclude fishing vessels under 15 metres and recreational craft under 45 metres. Format and access: the open raw stream is served over TCP at IP address 153.44.253.27, port 5631, in the IEC 62320-1 format, without registration; BarentsWatch offers AIS API endpoints and chart services from the same network, and Kystinfo shows open AIS on maps. Full data, including historical data and the excluded vessel classes, need a registration form stating the purpose and are mainly shared with public authorities and ports, with user-specific filters by area, vessels and update rate. Licence: open data under the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD); the closed data carry purpose-of-use and no-redistribution conditions. Caveats: coverage depends on shore station reception; the open feed is live only, so history must be collected by the user or requested; the BarentsWatch API documentation was not read. Simulation uses: live and recorded vessel movements for port and shipping lane traffic models, maritime emergency response and exposure of coastal infrastructure. Related records: the historical Kystdatahuset warehouse (data-norway-kystdatahuset-maritime-traffic) is built from the same AIS network, and AISdb (platform-aisdb) is a tool for storing and processing AIS streams.
